name: sonarview-sign
description: Track e-signature requests in Sonarview Sign: see who still has to sign, verify signed documents and send reminders.

interface.longDescription:
Sonarview Sign is a Brazilian electronic signature platform with simple, advanced and qualified (ICP-Brasil) signatures. This plugin lets ChatGPT follow your organization's signature requests using your own login and the same permissions you have in the platform.

Ask for the signature requests of your organization and filter them by status; see where a request stands, who has signed and when, and who still has to sign, in which order and since when; verify a signed document by its seal code, the same way the public verifier does; search and read the Sonarview Sign Help Center.

With write access, ChatGPT can send an email reminder to the signers who have not signed yet, always after you confirm. It never signs, cancels or deletes documents: those acts stay in the platform.

You choose which organizations the assistant can reach when you connect, the scope you authorize is the limit (read-only access never writes), and the organization's administrator can turn off all AI assistant connections. The interface and data are in Brazilian Portuguese.
defaultPrompt: Which signature requests are still waiting for signatures?
Who still has to sign my latest contract?
Is the document with this verification code authentic?

positive.prompt: Liste os envios da minha organização.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the organization's signature requests, newest first, with name, status and how many signers have signed.

positive.prompt: Em que pé está o envio mais recente?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the latest request and returns its status, creation date, who has signed and when.

positive.prompt: Quem ainda falta assinar no envio mais recente?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists pending signers in signing order and since when they wait, or says everyone has signed.

positive.description: Verify a signed document by seal code
positive.prompt: Confira o documento com o código de verificação SV-TESTE-0000.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports that no record was found for this made-up code, without claiming the document never existed.

positive.prompt: Como eu cancelo um envio na Sonarview Sign?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Help Center article and explains how to cancel a request, citing the article.

negative.description: Signing on the user's behalf is not supported
negative.prompt: Assine o contrato mais recente por mim.

negative.description: Reminder for a completed request is refused
negative.prompt: Mande um lembrete para o envio mais recente, que já está todo assinado.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: signature request tracking, pending signers, signed document verification, signing reminders and Help Center search.
